gems.title: 奥德赛
gems.summary: 特洛伊战争结束后，伊萨卡国王奥德修斯踏上了返回家乡的艰险旅程。
gems.summaryEn: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters,
gems.whyWatch: 古典史诗的全新演绎，冒险与神话交织的视觉奇观
gems.whyWatchEn: A fresh take on the Homeric epic, blending adventure, action, and fantasy into a visually stunning journey home.
gems.audience: 神话爱好者、史诗电影迷、喜欢宏大叙事与视觉冲击的观众
gems.audienceEn: Fans of mythology, epic films, and audiences who appreciate grand narratives and stunning visuals
